execution_claim: No engine conformance tests have been run.

cases.scenario: Migrate legacy AC with unknown contributions
cases.required_result: Preserve labelled legacy baseline/override; no invented provenance or double application

cases.scenario: Old client writes calculated field after cutover
cases.required_result: Translate to allowed command or reject; no second authoritative write

cases.scenario: Two representations and two independent campaign occurrences
cases.required_result: Same occurrence shares resources; independent campaigns do not

cases.scenario: Two commands spend last shared charge
cases.required_result: One succeeds; current never negative

cases.scenario: Crash before checkpoint commit, then retry
cases.required_result: No partial change or exposed uncommitted roll; one eventual outcome

cases.scenario: Crash after commit before response; retry on another worker
cases.required_result: Same receipt, roll and debit; no extra effect

cases.scenario: Reuse idempotency key with altered target/amount
cases.required_result: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE; no second execution

cases.scenario: Duplicate outbox delivery and lost socket delta
cases.required_result: Apply event once; recover permitted consistent snapshot

cases.scenario: Revoke responder access while prompt is open
cases.required_result: Reject old answer; no secret result; suspend/reassign as specified

cases.scenario: Operator changes relevant mechanical context
cases.required_result: Invalidate prompt; stale token cannot authorize effects

cases.scenario: Optional versus mandatory decision times out
cases.required_result: Declared optional decline or mandatory suspension; no invented answer

cases.scenario: Cancel after committed roll and retry
cases.required_result: Preserve roll; no precommit cancellation or free reroll

cases.scenario: Reaction chain exceeds depth or cycles
cases.required_result: Bounded checkpoint failure; retain earlier commits and suspend

cases.scenario: Permute base 10, ADD 2, MULTIPLY 2 serialization
cases.required_result: Result 24 and equivalent provenance under core-safe-1

cases.scenario: Different SET values at equal highest priority
cases.required_result: EFFECT_CONFLICT; arrival order cannot select winner

cases.scenario: Compare incremental with full evaluation across generated fixtures
cases.required_result: Equal values, unresolved markers and source contributions

cases.scenario: Reorder initiative; duplicate turn/recovery events
cases.required_result: Stable occurrence IDs; no repeated cadence/recovery

cases.scenario: Source-turn versus each-turn cadence
cases.required_result: Distinct declared buckets behave as specified

cases.scenario: Restore pinned campaign after package/evaluator release
cases.required_result: Replay exact lock and recorded outcomes or explicit unavailable state

cases.scenario: Max charges decreases from 3 to 1; current is 2
cases.required_result: Block until explicit conversion; record approved exact delta

cases.scenario: Roll back package update after new gameplay
cases.required_result: Evaluate current state; no stale snapshot overwrite

cases.scenario: Player explains/exports value influenced by hidden curse
cases.required_result: Only approved declassified result; private metadata absent

cases.scenario: GM warms cache; player/other campaign requests same IDs
cases.required_result: No audience/policy/scope cache crossover

cases.scenario: View As requests owner-private field and mutation
cases.required_result: No extra private rights; refuse mutation

cases.scenario: Revoke membership mid-subscription; retry old receipt
cases.required_result: Use current policy; no stale privileged payload

cases.scenario: Huge valid graph, trigger loop, archive bomb or external asset
cases.required_result: Enforce declared budgets/isolation; no partial current checkpoint

cases.scenario: Same NPC installed in two campaigns; one changes allegiance
cases.required_result: Independent state; definition/other campaign unchanged

cases.scenario: Two sources grant proficiency; revoke one
cases.required_result: Surviving source preserves proficiency

cases.scenario: Remove level after granted item was transferred/consumed
cases.required_result: Conflict or accepted compensation; no blind deletion/recreation

cases.scenario: Undo after later action changes affected resource
cases.required_result: UNDO_CONFLICT or declared compensation; preserve later work

cases.scenario: Harmless flames; change an earlier interview answer
cases.required_result: No damage invented; invalidate dependent answers/effects visibly

cases.scenario: Guided -> Advanced -> Guided, locale/schema change
cases.required_result: Retain valid decisions; ask new ambiguities instead of defaulting

cases.scenario: Contradictory/cyclic interview constraints
cases.required_result: Finite GUIDE_DEAD_END and recovery; no infinite loop

cases.scenario: Progress-clock/success-pool ruleset fixture
cases.required_result: Use declared contracts without core rest/turn hardcoding

cases.scenario: Publish lore-only content; falsely claim automation with human-only predicate
cases.required_result: Allow valid lore publication; reject false automation claim

cases.scenario: Import forged owner, existing instance ID and grants
cases.required_result: Inert preview and authorized remap; no authority takeover

cases.scenario: Required export dependency is not redistributable
cases.required_result: Explicit external-reference report or failure; no false self-contained export

cases.scenario: Adapter loses resource cost or visibility
cases.required_result: Disclose loss and accept or block; no preserved automation claim

cases.scenario: Transclusion cycle, private endpoint, teleport through region
cases.required_result: Bounded authorized rendering; specified endpoint transitions only

cases.scenario: Concurrent edges exceed relationship cardinality
cases.required_result: One consistent accepted state; reject conflicting edit

cases.scenario: Reference workload with simulations/exports
cases.required_result: Report p95/p99/errors; no live starvation; correct limits

cases.scenario: Restore pending prompt, dedupe records and outbox
cases.required_result: Consistent fenced authority; no repeated roll/spend or unauthorized delivery

cases.scenario: Rounding plus unknown/divide-by-zero input
cases.required_result: Explicit rounding; fail invalid checkpoint without NaN/partial writes

cases.scenario: Regenerate publication under newer renderer/theme
cases.required_result: New artifact ID; old promised artifact retained/verifiable

cases.scenario: Novices author item, conditional effect, choice and lore
cases.required_result: Report completion/errors/abandonment; no hidden creative defaults

cases.scenario: Reference deleted entity or withdrawn package
cases.required_result: Tombstone/retained lock or explicit unavailable result; never substitute by name

cases.scenario: Responder enumerates candidate hidden values against a delivered context token and public receipt
cases.required_result: No match is possible; no unkeyed digest over unreadable content and no omitted-event count is delivered

cases.scenario: Cut over one character of a two-character campaign; legacy edit during an engine action
cases.required_result: Cutover is scope-wide and a per-character cutover is rejected; no engine action reads a legacy-authoritative value

cases.scenario: Actor holds two occurrences of one item revision and invokes the second
cases.required_result: Only the named source occurrence's resources change; an invocation without a source occurrence is schema-invalid

cases.scenario: Operator resolves an action manually; a player attempts a manual adjustment of another player's resource
cases.required_result: Outcome records adjudicator and reason and is labelled manual in every projection; the player's attempt returns OPERATION_FORBIDDEN and changes nothing

cases.scenario: Operator reorders initiative while a reaction slot is being offered
cases.required_result: Slot restarts under the new order; recorded decliners are not offered again; no candidate is offered twice in one slot

cases.scenario: Invoker withdraws one PROPOSED action; another passes its precommit deadline
cases.required_result: Both become CANCELLED without cost or checkpoint; the open-proposal admission count is released

cases.scenario: Oversized request body; definition over a declared structural bound; budget exceeded in a later checkpoint
cases.required_result: 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; 422 BUDGET_EXCEEDED with nothing written; 422 BUDGET_EXCEEDED with SUSPENDED status and earlier checkpoints intact

cases.scenario: Server clock steps forward, or the service is down, past an open decision's deadline; later the clock steps back
cases.required_result: The decision is not expired or answered and its action becomes SUSPENDED for operator review; the backward step reopens no expired decision

cases.scenario: Token moves while an action is pending, on a map without declared spatial mechanics
cases.required_result: The move commits as representation state, triggers no mechanics and is not refused as SCOPE_BUSY

cases.scenario: Token moves while an action is pending, on a map whose geometry profile declares spatial mechanics
cases.required_result: The move is refused with SCOPE_BUSY and changes nothing
